system.description:
Add-On (Passive): Add-Ons are made to an item with the Clothes Set property. They take no item slot: denote them on the Clothing Set to which they are added.

Pocket (Passive): This item gives you 1 RIS. You may only place a Trinket in this RIS slot. You may add a maximum of 2 Pockets to any Clothing Set.

Hidden (Passive): This item is obscured. A creature must make a Perception: Sight or Perception: Touch Trait Check against your Check DC to identify this item.

No Item Slot · 10gc · Clothing Add-Ons, rulebook p.199
